title: Certify maps and set operators over sets in Lean via the clause log
summary: Maps of not/and/or/=> over sets, Z3's set operators (union, intersection, setminus, complement), and input default values over Int and Real indices are now certified in Lean through the clause log, with every new fact proved by rfl or a funext theorem and no new axiom. z3test t8.smt2 and two queries of issue-1665.smt2 now verify in Lean.
